purpose: Measure conditional Adam200 optimizability of random valid balanced-stellarator v2 prior samples.

source.selection: 84 samples drawn uniformly without replacement with seed 20260902
source.reason_for_conditioning: Invalid initial states are already measured C0 outcomes and cannot start the strict-continuation Adam optimizer.

optimizer.normalization_scale_source: frozen Flow checkpoint training-set coordinate standard deviations
optimizer.initial_geometry: preserved by unclipped affine coordinates and a per-start fixed current L1 reference
optimizer.direction_policy: fresh random orthogonal directions per update

resources.historical_runtime_basis: Direct-data Adam200 wall time p50 825.6 s and p90 1151.4 s over 309 trajectories.

interpretation: Conditional success among the 84 optimized valid starts is multiplied by the measured 0.375 initial-valid rate to estimate unconditional prior abundance.
default_impact: none; qh-flow-screen32-adam200-64d-abi11-v1 remains the current default
